update_active_memory.description: Updates one or more existing fields on an active memory record. Put every field to change inside `fields_to_update`; each key is the exact existing field name and each value is its new value.
rules: Use `fields_to_update` for every update, including a single field.
Keys inside `fields_to_update` must be exact existing field names on the target active memory record.
`conditions` can always be updated; other fields may only update custom state fields already declared on the active memory record.
